name: CopyEmojiMarkdown
description: Allows you to copy emojis as formatted string (<:blobcatcozy:1026533070955872337>)
summary: "Copy Emoji Markdown" in the emoji picker's menu: <:name:id>, or the emoji itself

settings.label: Copy Unicode
settings.description: Copy the raw unicode character instead of :name: for default emojis (👽)

notes: Right-clicking an emoji in the emoji picker offers "Copy Emoji Markdown": a server emoji copies as <:name:id> (<a:name:id> when animated, without the ~1 Discord adds to repeated names), and a standard emoji copies as the character itself, or as :name: with "Copy Unicode" off; "Success! Copied emoji markdown." confirms it.
